title: Fake4's Jump Reset Indicator
description: A client-side Fabric mod that measures and displays the timing accuracy of a player's jump reset after receiving knockback. Purely observational, no gameplay modification.
body:
# Fake4's Jump Reset Mod:
Fake4's Jump Reset Mod is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod that helps you practice jump reset timing after taking knockback.

It detects incoming velocity packets for your player, measures when you press jump afterward, and displays your timing on a clean HUD overlay with categories like Perfect, Good, Close, and Miss.

# Features:
Client-side only
No gameplay modification
No packet sending or knockback changes
Draggable HUD
Adjustable HUD scale
Configurable timing thresholds
Toggleable milliseconds/category display
Designed as a simple training overlay for PvP practice.

![Example of usage.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/99a6c64a10f104e8b089a1f4d3df5948f36dea5c.png)
